svg.title: Out-of-sample forecast errors by outcome and horizon
svg.desc: Forecast RMSE ratios compare models augmented with narrow FSI or broad MFSI against the same controls-only baseline across five outcomes and four horizons. Ratios below one indicate improvement. The graphs show mainly higher errors, with improvements for wholesale prices and pig iron at some longer horizons. Each cell reports its number of evaluated forecasts; the smallest count is nineteen for twelve-month rail-freight forecasts.
